title: poa autumnalis var. robusta
intro: Poa autumnalis var. robusta, commonly known as Autumn Bluegrass, is a variety of grass that is native to North America. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Autumn Bluegrass include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and clear the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
